title: Massive sell-off of semiconductor stocks triggers technical correction in Nasdaq 100 after SK Hynix disappoints
summary: Investors punish chipmakers after SK Hynix's record results fail to meet expectations, triggering a crash that spreads to Asian markets and hedge funds.

title: Apple reaches $5 trillion market capitalization for the first time
summary: The tech giant becomes the first company to be worth $5 trillion, consolidating its position as the most valuable in the world.

title: Federal Reserve begins two-day meeting amid geopolitical tensions and Wall Street declines
summary: Markets trade cautiously ahead of the Fed's expected decision to hold rates steady, while Trump's threats to Iran and tech earnings generate uncertainty.

title: Oil rises after Trump's threat to Iran and Houthi attack on Saudi ship in Red Sea
summary: The escalation in the Middle East drives oil and boosts Glencore's profits, while copper remains stable despite the crisis.

title: CaixaBank plummets more than 6% on stock market after presenting record results that fail to convince the market
summary: The Spanish bank leads losses on the Ibex 35 alongside Telefónica and Unicaja, and bearish investors increase their bets against the stock.

title: Cathie Wood buys Nvidia shares again amid tech sector downturn
summary: The founder of ARK Investment acquires Nvidia shares for the second time, sparking debate among analysts about whether it is a buy signal.

title: Wave of debt from hyperscalers boosts yields and cools investor demand
summary: The massive bond issuance by big tech companies to finance artificial intelligence pushes yields up and reduces investor appetite.
